item.title: Family surrendered dog to shelter after dressing him up in hoodie
item.description: Ninja’s owners dressed him in a hoodie, as if the cute outfit would make it easier for their family dog to survive in an overcrowded animal shelter after they surrendered him. His owners told the shelter they could no longer afford his dog.
